executionModel.commitOwner: The orchestrator commits on wf/bass after the run with the AGENTS.md 1-6 section message and pushes only wf/bass, never main. executionModel.retryPolicy: Wave 1 and wave 4 plans share one cargo target dir. If cargo reports a lock, or a sibling's file fails to compile mid-edit, wait about 60 s and retry, up to 10 times, then record a blocker in the plan's Progress Log. Never edit a sibling's file.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record its sha256 in the Progress Log. If it drifted from the expected state, stop and reconcile only the plan's own intent. After editing, record the post-edit sha256. Never edit outside writePaths/sharedPaths.

designDecisionsAndRationale: One kernel bass-core with a per-template literal mode port (0..5) instead of six kernels: one codec tag, one port list, one natives entry, fewer shared-registry edits.
New UGen justified by the diode ladder, feedback FM, slide, tempo-relative gate length and per-sample filter wobble that existing UGens cannot express.
TPT/ZDF transistor and diode ladders with a single input tanh per sample, cutoff recomputed every sample.
Note-off owned by the kernel through gate-length in sixteenth-steps of 1/(16*cps) s; kx.gate ignored, like the self-enveloped drum cores, so existing env-adsr gates and digests stay unchanged.
Slide is an explicit per-event slide-from (semitones from the previous note) plus slide-time settle-to-1%, used with cut 1; legato notes do not retrigger the amp or filter envelope.

Wobble LFO reimplements the digital-drum formulas (rate_hz = lfo_rate * cps when synced; transport-locked phase frac(rate_hz * onset) in f64) without importing digital_drum; divisions 1/4=4, 1/8=8, 1/4T=6, 1/8T=12.
template_default_override generalized minimally to Float/Bool so editor defaults match bass headers, keeping existing Enum results identical.
template_slots raised 72 -> 80 so the 73rd template installs (73 prelude + 2 live-input + 4 quad-stem = 79).
BASS-30 creates the bass_render.rs helper and wave-4 placeholder test files so BASS-40 and BASS-41 run in parallel with disjoint files.
intentionalTradeoffs: Slide interval is user-written, not inferred; during the 3 ms cut crossfade the old and new voice states are independent; no accent build-up across consecutive accents; slide notes start with a decayed filter envelope.
Live-input or MIDI held keys do not sustain past gate-length (user-QA BQ2, option A).
No oversampling: filter saturation at high drive may alias; accepted for bass.
Kernel is mono; reese and wobble width come from effects in examples.
Implicit row-named ports get the controls.rs row default (for example lfo-sync 0) when a template does not pass them; documented, not fixed with literals.
Automated checks (non-silence, peak, low-band share) only partly prove the sound; WAVs in tmp/bass/ support a manual listening pass.
supportedEdgeCases: Non-finite port values and inputs: components reset state and return 0; sanitize flushes denormals and non-finite values.
Extreme controls: freq 20/2000, cutoff 20/20000, res 1, drive 1, index 32, fm-feedback 1, fold 1, bit-depth 2, lfo-depth +/-1, slide-from +/-24, rendered 2 s finite and |y| <= 1.
cps 0 or non-finite clamps to 0.03 or 0.5; onset-time up to 3600 s keeps phase accuracy via f64.
Voice finish zeroes all state floats and later blocks output zeros.
Bypass exactness: fold 0, bit-depth 16 and click-level 0 are bit-identical passes.
Tempo changes: wobble period follows use-bpm (120 vs 150 BPM e2e test).
Preset fn piping fallback: zero-argument fns if a fn-returned pattern cannot be piped.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Automatic previous-note slide detection (user-QA BQ1, deferred engine handoff).
Held-key sustain beyond gate-length for live input/MIDI (BQ2).
Hardware-accurate accent capacitor accumulation and per-stage diode nonlinearities with Newton iteration.
Stereo kernel output and oversampled filters.

Session 232 LFO revision: Lfo is the six-float drift-free layout (anchor_phase, anchor_cycles, count_lo, count_hi, rate, smooth; FLOATS = 6) with the phase derived in f64 from an exact split sample count, re-anchoring on a bit-level rate change, and accessors cycles(sr)/phase(sr); no incremental phase accumulation remains.
